reason: A backup and synchronization utility that creates local DSH snapshots, restores them, transfers them incrementally through WebDAV, and performs scheduled retention cleanup.

summaries.zh: 用于创建和恢复 DeepSeek Harness 本地快照，并通过 WebDAV 在设备间增量同步数据的备份工具。
summaries.en: A backup utility for creating and restoring DeepSeek Harness snapshots and incrementally syncing them across machines through WebDAV.

capabilities: Creates and manages local snapshots of DSH session, workspace, and configuration data
Restores selected snapshot data and may overwrite current files
Uploads and downloads snapshot files through WebDAV
Runs scheduled backups and retention-based cleanup
Can optionally include attachments and credential files in backups
